name: Mahou Shoujo Pastel ☆ Hearts ~Ingoku! Shokushu Seisan Souchi Hen~
original_name: 魔法少女パステル☆ハーツ ～淫獄!触手生産装置編～
source:
The defeated magical girl carries evil in her belly...!

The Magic Stone... 
The source of infinite magic power only designated to the chosen ones.
The bearers of pure hearts, "Magical Girl Pastel*Hearts" are selected by the stone.
Ruria Tachibana is empowered as one of the team, the "Pastel*Peach".

She protects the people from the venomous fangs of the invaders 
together with her close friend Kanami Shinonome, the "Pastel*Mint".

One day, Kanami leaves town due to some business. 
In the absence of Pastel*Mint, what lewd fate awaits Pastel*Peach...!?

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE229327.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
战败的魔法少女腹中携带着邪恶……！

魔法石……

只会将无限魔力赋予被选中者的源泉。
拥有纯洁心灵的“魔法少女Pastel*Hearts”由魔法石选出。
立花露莉亚获得力量，成为团队成员“Pastel*Peach”。

她与亲密好友东云香奈美——“Pastel*Mint”——一起，保护人们免受侵略者毒牙的侵害。

某天，香奈美因为某件事离开城镇。
在Pastel*Mint不在期间，Pastel*Peach将迎来怎样的淫靡命运……！？

（来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE229327.html]DLsite English[/url]）
